_sources: rubble is the stone source and timber is the timber source; a pile hands over one block's worth of its material. Their order is a save key: appending a cell is safe, inserting or reordering one makes a mid-run save think a different pile is the one it already emptied today. Timber is not in the village on day 1 - the piles exist but stay inert until day 2 - so a timber cell may sit on ground the player walks over on the first day.
_convention: rows[0] is the TOP row. Every x/y in this file and in npcs.json is a tilemap CELL coordinate with y growing UP, so the tile under an entity at (x,y) is rows[height - 1 - y][x]. A space is void: off-map, never walkable.
_shape: A circular city. The ring is the wall, broken open in three stretches; the run of W along y=22 is the stretch this player is assigned, which is why it is straight. The centre is left clear for the gathering.
